transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the weekly training synchronization for next week's sustainment-training cycle. I'll go around the room for roster, qualification, scheduling, and facility updates before I publish the final schedule. As a reminder, the draft has Transport Section vehicle-recovery training on Tuesday 0900 to 1100 and Generator Section load-bank training on Wednesday 0900 to 1100. Who'd like to start with roster updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I completed my roster audit this morning. Five of the eight Transport operators lack current vehicle-recovery-equipment qualification and must attend the recertification block on Tuesday. The other three are already qualified. I should note the updated roster hasn't been entered in the training tracker yet, so I'll get that done today.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a facility conflict. I confirmed this morning that the Generator Training Pad is reserved for calibration work on Wednesday from 0900 to 1300. That directly conflicts with the Generator Section's load-bank training in the draft schedule. The load-bank session needs to be moved to Monday from 1300 to 1500. I should also note that the facility calendar still shows the recurring Wednesday slot, so it hasn't been updated yet to reflect the calibration reservation.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both. SFC Morgan, good catch on the qualifications — so five of eight Transport operators must attend Tuesday's vehicle-recovery recertification. Please get that roster update into the training tracker today. WO1 Patel, understood on the Generator Training Pad conflict. Wednesday 0900 to 1300 is reserved for calibration, so we'll need to move the Generator Section load-bank training. Monday 1300 to 1500 sounds like your recommendation — before I lock that in, does anyone have any conflicts with Monday afternoon for the Generator Section? Also, are there any qualification concerns on the Generator side I should be aware of?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, on the Generator Section qualifications — I haven't completed a roster audit for the Generator Section yet, so I can't speak to whether any of the six technicians have qualification concerns for load-bank operation. I'd recommend we get confirmation from the Generator Section lead before locking in the Monday session. As for Monday afternoon conflicts on my end, I don't have any Transport Section training scheduled that would overlap, so no conflict from me.
